title: Police respond to a verbal altercation between Rivera and Ellison in the employer's parking lot.

quote: On March 4, 2024 I reported in writing to Mark Ellison that the brakes on forklift #7 were failing.

title: Ellison calls Rivera into his office and tells her to stop filing safety reports.
quote: On March 12, 2024 he called me into his office and told me to stop filing safety reports.

title: Rivera is sent home without pay two days after the meeting.
quote: Two days later I was sent home without pay.

quote: I am filing a formal complaint.

quote: HR has opened an investigation and scheduled an interview with you for March 27, 2024.

title: Investigation interview rescheduled (on March 25) from March 27 to March 28, 2024.

title: Investigation interview with Rivera held.
quote: The investigation interview with Ms. Rivera was held on March 28, 2024.

title: Rivera's employment terminated.

quote: filed a charge of retaliation with the State Civil Rights Division on May 28, 2024
